question: Which divine guardians are assigned to protect the flanks and the belly?
premises: The lord of the family is invoked to protect the two flanks.
The delighter of the Ikṣvāku lineage is invoked to protect the belly.
Distinct body parts are placed under specific divine guardianship.
inference: Protective guardianship is apportioned to the flanks and belly through named deities.
uncertainties: The exact identity of kulapatiḥ is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: May the lord of the family protect the two sides, and may the delighter of the Ikṣvāku lineage protect the belly.
